method: Whole-view comparison of each panorama (1148x1063, pitched up) with its dry render at the same size from the same camera at 90 degree vertical field of view; positions read on each feature's own row.
note: Measured from the pass 77 and pass 78 panoramas looking north (about 3.4 m from these fronts). Their base rows put the fronts about 0.8 m behind the district outline; the fronts are kept on the outline, as in pass 76, and each camera was moved by that amount (cameras 1.95 m above these houses). Positions from two headings per camera agree within about 0.2 m, except the red house's west edge, which reads 1.4 m east of the outline in both views; the joint to the white annex is set at the measured 256.3. The white house's footprint is OSM way 90859904, an untagged member of a multipolygon that the district import dropped. Roofs, depths and yard sides are estimates.
